 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. South Carolina football wants to continue building a winning streak in the game against Texas A&M on Nov. 7 at Williams-Brice Stadium.
 The Gamecocks (5-3, 3-3 SEC) have won three games in a row , all in conference. The streak includes last week's 42-25 win at Oklahoma. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Texas A&M (4-4, 1-4) has recorded a lone SEC win this season, against Arkansas. Otherwise, the Aggies have posted four losses by double digits in league play.
 Here's what you need to know about today's game, including time, TV schedule and streaming information:
 MOVING ON AND GETTING OVER: Why Shane Beamer got advice from basketball coaches like Rick Pitino during losing streak 
 What channel is South Carolina football vs Texas A&M on today?
 TV channel: ESPN
 Livestream: Fubo (free trial) | ESPN app, ESPN Unlimited 
 South Carolina football vs Texas A&M will broadcast nationally on ESPN in Week 10 of the 2026 college football season. Roy Philpott and Brock Osweiler will call the game from the booth at Williams-Brice Stadium, with Stormy Buonantony reporting from the sidelines. Streaming options for the game include Fubo , which includes a free trial for new subscribers.

 South Carolina football vs Texas A&M start time
 Date: Saturday, Nov. 7
 Start time: 3 p.m.
 The South Carolina football vs Texas A&M game starts at 3 p.m. from Williams-Brice Stadium in Columbia.
